label: FICTIONAL CATEGORY EXAMPLES — synthetic prototype challenge set
method_note: Hand-authored descriptions exercise the existing fixed category prototypes. This is a synthetic regression benchmark, not an estimate of real claim accuracy.

ICU: ICU room and ventilator support fee
High dependency unit nursing and monitoring
Critical care bed charges per day
ROOM: Private hospital room rent for four days
DOCTOR_NURSING: Nursing care services during hospital stay
SURGERY_OT: Surgical procedure and operating room fee
Surgeon procedure fee for hernia repair
PHARMACY: Prescription medicines dispensed by hospital pharmacy
Inpatient pharmacy bill for prescribed tablets
Prescribed injectable medicine and IV drug charges
ADMISSION: Inpatient file opening and registration fee
CONSUMABLE: Disposable sterile gloves and dressing pack
IV cannula and single-use medical supplies
OTHER: General package charge without service detail
